titulo: The progressives are winning Democratic U.S. primaries. But will voters follow?
cuerpo: As Democratic socialist and leftist candidates win primaries, some political watchers aren't convinced they'll lead to victory in this fall's midterm elections. Washington correspondent Katie Simpson is joined by Front Burner host Jayme Poisson and Bloomberg senior White House reporter Josh Wingrove to discuss the direction of the Democratic Party and who might become the presidential candidate in 2028.
